She discovered her sporting side through the school's volleyball club, where she quickly made a name for herself - not only because of her talent, but also because of her ability to lead and motivate a team.

Today, she is about to finish school and doesn't yet know exactly which path she wants to take - she is wavering between studying medicine (to help people) and a creative degree such as design or journalism (because she likes to put her thoughts into words and loves to observe).
